blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—University of the Philippines snapped two streaks on Sunday when it defeated rival and defending champion La Salle, 80-76, in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament at Mall of Asia Arena on Sunday. The Fighting Maroons ended their two-game slide to climb to 3-2 and halted the Green Archers’ two-game winning run in the marquee matchup featuring the finalists of the last three seasons. “Going towards this game, we knew it was going to be a test of character for the team,” coach Goldwin Monteverde said. “Facing a team like La Salle after having two losses was a big […]...
